tax.text: McDowell voted to advance legislation that his office said would lock in tax cuts for families and small businesses.
tax.quote: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act locks in tax cuts for hardworking families and small businesses; opens up American energy production; reins in regulatory overreach; right-sizes our bloated bureaucracy by rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse; and secures our border and strengthens our military.

trade.text: McDowell criticized the free-trade agenda and endorsed an America First approach intended to protect American jobs.
trade.quote: North Carolinians have all seen how a community can be decimated by the free-trade agenda pushed by previous Presidents, Democrat and Republican alike. That’s why I support President Trump’s America First Agenda that protects and promotes American jobs.

schools.text: McDowell's official congressional website says he has supported school-choice and parental-rights legislation.
schools.quote: McDowell has supported those priorities in Congress through school choice and parental-rights legislation, Title IX protections for women and girls, conscience protections, pro-life legislation and stronger online safeguards for children.

safety.text: McDowell secured $3.5 million for a combined police, fire, and emergency-services facility in Lexington.
safety.quote: The funding would be used to construct a new building that houses the city’s emergency services. Funding would go toward the construction of a new combined facility for the city’s fire station and police department.

immigration.text: McDowell calls securing the southern border and stopping illegal drug flows a personal priority.
immigration.quote: We must secure the Southern Border and stop the flow of illegal drugs from flooding into our country. This isn’t just a talking point for me, it’s personal.

guns.text: McDowell says he will oppose government actions that restrict Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: I believe that the right to self-defense is a God-given, constitutional right of every law-abiding American. As an avid hunter and gun enthusiast, I will fight government overreach that aims to disrupt North Carolinians’ 2nd Amendment rights.

abortion.text: McDowell's official congressional website says he has supported pro-life legislation.
abortion.quote: McDowell has supported those priorities in Congress through school choice and parental-rights legislation, Title IX protections for women and girls, conscience protections, pro-life legislation and stronger online safeguards for children.

gender.text: McDowell's official congressional website says he has supported Title IX protections for women and girls.
gender.quote: McDowell has supported those priorities in Congress through school choice and parental-rights legislation, Title IX protections for women and girls, conscience protections, pro-life legislation and stronger online safeguards for children.

energy.text: McDowell voted to advance legislation described by his office as opening American energy production and reducing regulation.
energy.quote: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act locks in tax cuts for hardworking families and small businesses; opens up American energy production; reins in regulatory overreach; right-sizes our bloated bureaucracy by rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse; and secures our border and strengthens our military.

voting.text: McDowell supports voter-identification requirements, tighter absentee-ballot restrictions, election-day receipt deadlines and signature verification.
voting.quote: We should also tighten restrictions on absentee voting, so that all votes are received by election day & signature verification is used to ensure voter fraud doesn’t occur.

tax.text: Jefferson presented economic, public-safety, and social-policy priorities while promising not to raise taxes.
tax.quote: securing the well-being of North Carolina families—all without raising taxes.

trade.text: Jefferson opposes broad tariffs that raise costs while supporting targeted trade policies.
trade.quote: Oppose reckless tariffs that act as hidden taxes on working families.

debt.text: Jefferson pledges to protect Medicare and Medicaid benefits.
debt.quote: Protect Medicaid and Medicare for North Carolina families and seniors.

housing.text: Jefferson supports expanding housing supply and cutting regulatory barriers to homebuilding.
housing.quote: Expand housing supply and cut red tape that makes it harder

safety.text: Jefferson supports both modern policing and investments in mental-health response and youth intervention.
safety.quote: modern policing, expanded mental health resources, and proven youth intervention programs

immigration.text: Jefferson supports expanding legal visa pathways alongside border-security measures and employment verification.
immigration.quote: Fix our broken immigration system. He’ll expand legal visa pathways, streamline hiring for trusted employers, and protect American wages with E-Verify.

abortion.text: Jefferson says abortion decisions should remain a person's choice rather than the government's.
abortion.quote: it’s someone else’s right to choose the healthcare that is most helpful to them.
